learning_objective: 🎯 We will learn about fun patterns, beautiful shapes, and counting things during festivals!

main_concepts.simple_explanation: Look at the colorful flower garlands on the door. It has one leaf, then one flower, then one leaf again! This is called a pattern because it repeats.
We make beautiful Rangoli during festivals. Can you see circles, triangles, and squares in the design? Shapes make our Rangoli look so pretty!
Yummy laddoos are in the box and diyas are on the wall! Let us count them one by one. Counting helps us know how many fun things we have.

fun_activity.title: 🎨 Make a Bindi Pattern
fun_activity.instructions: Take red and green bindis from your mother. Stick them on a paper to make a repeating pattern like: red, green, red, green!

quick_recap: ⭐ A pattern is something that repeats over and over again.
⭐ We can find shapes like circles and triangles in festive decorations.
⭐ We can count diyas, sweet boxes, and flowers to practice math!
